before.requirement: Release a saved, unattached last_comment during parser destruction.
before.reason: The fixed harness creates the parser with flags 0. The supplied comment-saving path requires UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS; the before destructor has no last_comment release.

after.requirement: Release a saved, unattached last_comment during parser destruction.
after.reason: The fixed parser setup does not enable the shown comment-saving path. Even if destruction occurs with last_comment set, the after destructor releases it.

claims.reason: The before destructor lacks the release; the after destructor performs it whenever the frozen destruction condition holds. The harness’s error return concerns whether destruction occurs, so it is a different obligation.
